metadata.description: presence-app: give your AI a way to remember. Scriptorium writes the record; Antechamber finds it again.

plugins.name: scriptorium
plugins.description: Turns your chat history into memories you can check, each with its exact words, source lines and real date; keeps a people roster that fills itself. Talks to your own Scriptorium server.

plugins.name: antechamber
plugins.description: One question searches every store you connect (notes, chats, memories, a vault) and returns only the best matches. Starts itself on your computer.
